evals.name: Build the page XML write path
evals.description: Test that the skill points at the existing parser/import seams and scopes new work to the missing write path
evals.prompt: I need to add page XML emit support to the CMS so we can write page data back to ShopSite. Where do I start?
expected_output: Explains that page parsing, Zod identities, and import/preflight services already exist (page-parser.ts, schemas/page.ts) and must not be rebuilt
References page-xml-structure.md for the confirmed root/DOCTYPE/identity tags and page-codebase-gaps.md for the write-path scope
Recommends starting from the real-export fixture (src/tests/fixtures/shopsite-pages-bay-state-redacted.xml) as the shape reference
Outlines the remaining work: emit layer → tests → HTTP client, following the product codec encode pattern
Cross-references the ShopSiteProductCodec encode pattern (explicit emit + unknown/block preservation) for implementation guidance
Warns that unlisted field tags and emit-side relationship encoding still need export confirmation; root, DTD, and identity tags are already confirmed
Notes the preservation constraints that must be followed

evals.name: Page layout fields reference
evals.description: Test that the skill correctly identifies layout-related page fields
evals.prompt: What page fields control the layout and display of products on a ShopSite page?
expected_output: Lists: Columns, Page Link Columns, Item Alignment, Display column borders?, Page Width, Order, Products Sort Field, Pages Sort Field, Products First, Number Products, Text Wrap, Template
Gives type and default for each field
Notes that XML tag names are inferred and recommends confirming from a real export
Explains what each field does at a high level

evals.name: ProductOnPages current handling
evals.description: Test that the skill explains the current ProductOnPages handling as a first-class codec field
evals.prompt: How is ProductOnPages currently handled in the codebase? What does that mean for page-product relationships?
expected_output: Explains that ProductOnPages is a first-class core.productOnPages array resolved by the product codec (extractPageNamesFromBlock / resolveProductPageNames)
References page-codebase-gaps.md for the detailed explanation

Describes the extractPageNamesFromBlock function in src/shopsite/product-codec.ts:670-700 that parses page names from <Name>/<PageName>/<PageLink> tags, and the <ProductOnPages><PageLink><Name> emit layout
Points out that the CMS round-trips product page assignments but cannot emit page XML or manage assignments from the page side
Notes that ProductLinks (page-side) is parsed but page-side emission is not yet implemented
Recommends the real-export fixture as the shape reference before implementing page-side emit support
